\begin{document}
For real $a$ and $c$, take fermionic Matsubara frequencies.  In the following
fermionic Matsubara sum, $n$ is restricted to nonnegative frequencies only:
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{\beta}\sum_n \frac{1}{(\mathrm{i}\omega_n-a)(\mathrm{i}\omega_n-c)}
= \frac{n_F(a)-n_F(c)}{a-c} .
\label{eq:positive-frequency-sum}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
